corepack: not exposed; actual installer npm fallback selected through an explicit Node/npm-only tool PATH

platformTools.Python: provided CPython 3.12–3.14; record exact version, executable hash and subprocess source hash before target release

platformTools.admission: These platform ranges are proposed stable API constraints, not an assertion that exact current hosted versions are already admitted. Root/challenger must approve preflight inventory gate before execution.
